text:
elaine: CI is red on main — looks like a bunch of authz integration tests failing in the job. first failure at 1813456789 :(
sam: @elaine link to the failing pipeline?
elaine: https://ci.internal/red/12345 -> see test/authz_integration_test.py::test_policy_fetch
mike: +1, logs show connection refused to authz-mock on 127.0.0.1:8083
jen: we run authz-mock as a sidecar in the job config, maybe the init step failed
infra-bot: [alert] job authz-integ-12345 failed: sidecar "authz-mock" terminated (exit code 1)
sam: can someone share the container logs for authz-mock? maybe config changed
elaine: paste of last 10 lines:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z INFO starting authz-mock v0.9.2
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z ERROR failed to bind 127.0.0.1:8083: address already in use
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z INFO shutting down
```
mike: hmm address already in use — maybe previous test left a process holding the port in the CI runner image
jen: that runner uses containerd and recent kernel patch seems to have changed ephemeral port handling. cc @sam for runner infra
sam: on it. quick workaround: I'll update the job to use a random port and set AUTHZ_MOCK_PORT env var, then schedule a rerun
elaine: would rather avoid patching every job. can we just restart the runner pool to clear stale socket state?
sam: rolling restart of the ephemeral-runner pool in progress, ETA ~2m :hourglass:
ci-bot: re-run requested: authz-integ-12345 by sam
mike: while rolling, suggestion: add `--reuse-ports=false` to the authz-mock startup so it fails fast instead of binding silently
jen: added small change to the test image to set env AUTHZ_BIND_REUSE=0, pushing quick image tag authz-mock:ci-fix
elaine: thanks. if the pool restart doesn't help we'll re-run with the new image
sam: pool restart completed, verified no stale processes on runners
ci-bot: pipeline re-run started: build 12346
mike: watching logs...
ci-bot: job authz-integ-12346: authz-mock started on 127.0.0.1:8083
elaine: test suite progressing, looks like several tests that previously timed out are now passing :thumbsup:
ci-bot: pipeline passed: build 12346
elaine: ok great — root cause was stale port/socket in runner image causing authz-mock bind error. action items:
  - sam: add a preflight to clear sockets on runner (or force container network cleanup)
  - infra: monitor for similar bind errors and alert
  - jen: keep authz-mock to respect non-reuse bind flag in CI image
sam: noted. I'll open a follow-up ticket and include the logs + fix checklist
elaine: thanks everyone, closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
